title: The Jackal and the Drum
moral: Do not be afraid without understanding the truth.

story: Once upon a time, a hungry jackal was wandering in a forest. He had not eaten for many days and was very weak. As he walked, he suddenly heard a loud sound. “Dum! Dum! Dum!” The jackal became frightened. “What is that noise?” he thought. “Maybe it is a dangerous animal!” But he was also very hungry. So he slowly walked toward the sound. Soon, he found a big drum lying near a tree. The wind was blowing, and the branches were hitting the drum, making the loud noise. The jackal felt relieved. “Oh! It’s just a drum,” he said. He jumped on it and tore it open. But inside, there was nothing to eat. The jackal laughed at himself. “I was scared for no reason,” he said.
